notes.title: Pyramid Store Now Available!
notes.content:
Today, Pyramid Game officially launched the Pyramid Store. Players can explore the in-game bank page to discover how to exchange pyramids and assets. As with our original intent, we don't see this as microtransactions, but rather as providing a way to make it possible for the game to have contact with reality. Similarly, the pricing in the pyramid store is in no way intended to be purchased by players, but rather serves as a price reference, and the price of anything should be determined by the market with no right to interfere. Our policy of dropping a random pyramid every hour is more of a benefit to all pyramid citizens from the Pyramid DAO. In the future, whatever decision we make must only result in fewer and fewer pyramids being issued. More importantly, it is now best that any player does not attempt to modify or delete the game data or cheat in any way, as we have added a pyramid monitoring system that will instantly wipe out the player's assets without alerting them to any anomalies in the data. Of course, the punishment is only that, we will not prohibit players from re-entering the Pyramid New World, because we the Pyramid Citizen, we are born equal, with freedom and democracy, and we hold these truths to be self-evident and inalienable.
